name: Cleavers

facts.how: Cooked as a potherb; dried as tea

caution: The clinging hairs soften with cooking; eat it cooked rather than raw. A safe, well-known plant. Never eat a wild plant on this guide's word alone. Confirm identity against several sources and learn the look-alikes first.

sections.title: Identification
sections.body: A sprawling square-stemmed plant with whorls of narrow leaves and tiny hooks that make it cling to clothing, giving it the nickname 'sticky willy.'

sections.title: Uses
sections.body: Young growth cooks down into a mild green; the dried plant makes a traditional tea, and the seeds have been roasted as a coffee substitute.
